page_title: Orkas — Direct your AI team by chat, and scale your business.

sources.entry: Orkas - Turns project goals and local files into reports, presentations and code with a coordinated AI team in an open-source, local-first desktop workspace, using managed models or supported own-provider access. #opensource

summary.name: Orkas
summary.one_liner: Orkas is a free, MIT-licensed open-source desktop app for macOS and Windows where you direct a coordinated team of AI agents by chat to produce research, reports, slides, videos, websites and code.
use_cases: Turn a product launch brief into a video, product page copy and social posts
Run weekly store reporting: sales, reviews and stock briefs
Prepare client update decks from project numbers
Build and fix small apps or features with tests
Research markets and turn findings into reports or presentations
Automate recurring business tasks on a schedule
summary.what_it_does: Orkas is a desktop app where you set a goal in chat and a Commander agent coordinates specialist agents (research, content writing, image, video, voice, slide design, office work, UI design, development, SEO and e-commerce roles) to complete the work. It can run recurring tasks on a schedule, catching up missed runs when the computer wakes, and it saves preferences and facts from chats into a reviewable Memory. Files, chats and memory are stored on the user's machine, and users can choose their model: Orkas-managed official models or their own provider via OAuth or API key, plus connections to coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. Published web apps are possible on eligible plans, but those apps cannot use desktop AI, local files or connectors.
notable: MIT-licensed open source desktop app with code on GitHub
Local-first: files, chats and memory stay on the user's machine; API keys encrypted locally
Commander agent coordinates a team of specialist agents, with recurring scheduled tasks
Bring your own model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.) or use managed models
caveats: Managed model usage consumes credits; paid plans (Lite, Pro, Max) add monthly credits, multi-device sync and more cloud storage
Cloud features such as sync, managed models and shared projects require an Orkas account
Publishing web apps requires an eligible plan, and published apps cannot use desktop AI, local files or connectors
Remote control is planned, not available yet
